description: GEO-U1 Slice H1 continuation (v1/v2/v3 kept immutable): one exact 5m crypto PERSISTENT_COMPRESSION case.

cases.provenance: Scanner candidate 6a128fe677ea9f11b403e852.json + Bybit v5 public kline closed prefix; recorded anchor prices cross-checked.

expectation.note: production_* observed from this fixture on current main; recorded_runtime_* is historical (forming candle, older code), never asserted equal

search.necessary_condition_filter: realized segment range (max high - min low; last 30 closed bars as 3x10, and the same window shifted one bar earlier) last/first <= 0.9 with every step <= +5%. This is the realized half of the unchanged SHADOW PERSISTENT_COMPRESSION rule (compression_max_ratio 0.9, segment_tolerance 0.05, 30 bars, 3 segments), so a record failing it cannot be PERSISTENT_COMPRESSION. It orders/filters work only; it is not evidence.
search.queue_rule: necessary-condition pass and recorded anchor prices match fixture; ordered by exact SHADOW pair count then case_id; exact unchanged Slice D report until the first SELECTED/PERSISTENT_COMPRESSION

observed_readiness_all_linear.readiness_rule: exact_cases>=12; provenance complete for all; selected PERSISTENT_COMPRESSION>=3; selected EXPANSION>=2; selected NO_PERSISTENT_WIDTH_TREND>=3; no-admissible-pair cases>=2; production detected cases>=3; selected PERSISTENT_COMPRESSION/EXPANSION count only when independently reproduced (two separate runs, one with future rows, identical report)
unrecoverable_targets: robot_candidates without scanner_source_candle_time_ms (CASHCATUSDT 1m x3, ENAUSDT 1m x1, 2026-09-12..14)

observed_readiness_target_population.readiness_rule: exact_cases>=12; provenance complete for all; selected PERSISTENT_COMPRESSION>=3; selected EXPANSION>=2; selected NO_PERSISTENT_WIDTH_TREND>=3; no-admissible-pair cases>=2; production detected cases>=3; selected PERSISTENT_COMPRESSION/EXPANSION count only when independently reproduced (two separate runs, one with future rows, identical report)
unrecoverable_targets: robot_candidates without scanner_source_candle_time_ms (CASHCATUSDT 1m x3, ENAUSDT 1m x1, 2026-09-12..14)

observed_target_concentration_h0_rule.rule: DATA_CONCENTRATION_BLOCKER if one symbol is > 50% of target cases, one timeframe is > 75% of target cases, or any hard-gate class (A, B, D) draws all of its cases from one symbol or from one timeframe.
